units.source_text: 在雪里把精力倾注在手工活上的纺织女工，她们的生活可不像织出来的绉纱那样爽快。

en.t: The women weavers who poured their energy into handwork in the snow did not live lives as brisk and bright as the crepe they wove.

units.source_text: 这个镇子自然而然地给人一个相当古老的印象。

en.t: The town naturally gave one a rather old-fashioned impression.

units.source_text: 在记载绉纱的古书里，也引用了唐代秦韬玉

en.t: Old books that recorded crepe also quoted the Tang poet Qin Taoyu

units.source_text: ［秦韬玉，唐诗人。诗以七律见长，《贫女诗》较有名］的诗。

en.t: poems by Qin Taoyu, a Tang poet known for regulated verse and especially for The Poor Girl.

units.source_text: 但据说纺织商之所以不愿雇佣纺织女工，

en.t: But it is said that textile merchants were unwilling to hire women weavers

units.source_text: 是因为织一匹绉纱相当费工，在经济上划不来。

en.t: because weaving a single bolt of crepe took a great deal of labor and did not pay economically.
